title: Bobby
desc: Raja, a wealthy businessman's son, falls head over heels for Bobby, a fisherman's daughter. But with their families against their love, will they fight for their happily ever after?

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart?

title: Karan Arjun
desc: Durga's sons, Karan and Arjun, set out to avenge their father's death but are killed by their cruel uncle. Years later, they are reincarnated to deliver justice.

title: Butterfly
desc: Two children are kidnapped. To find them, authorities launch Operation Butterfly, and the story shows several intercut scenes of the search as the investigation unfolds with multiple perspectives.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
desc: A powerful smuggler faces a vengeful enemy while juggling politics and crime. A public apology sparks a tense showdown that leads to a dramatic challenge.

title: Rahu Ketu (2026)
desc: A writer's magical notebook brings two quirky characters to life. When it's stolen, Rahu and Ketu take on a dangerous mission against a drug mafia to reclaim it.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Veere Di Wedding
desc: Kalindi's friends Avni, Sakshi, and Meera reunite for her wedding. Sakshi takes them to Thailand, where they rediscover themselves and confront their personal struggles.
